description: Austrian healthcare resilience ABM is published by healthcare-resilience research team. The agent-based model stress-tests a healthcare network by removing doctors and simulating service disruption. Its stated coverage is Austria; the healthcare system described in the study. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The repository accompanies one paper; reuse beyond that study was not established. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
